backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.featureDescription: Your temple and your faith's followers can provide healing, shelter, and social access when your requests are reasonable and non-hazardous.
ideals: Tradition. Preserve sacred rites and ancient doctrine.
Charity. Aid people in need whatever the personal cost.
Faith. Trust in divine guidance through hardship.
bonds: I owe my life to the clergy who raised me.
I will protect my temple from corruption and ruin.
I seek to recover a relic of my faith.
flaws: I am rigid in doctrine and slow to reconsider.
I can be judgemental toward people outside my faith.
I become obsessive once I commit to a holy goal.
personalityTraits: I quote scripture in almost every conversation.
I look for omens in everyday events.
I try to calm conflict before it becomes violence.

lore.shortDescription: A servant of a temple or sacred order who carries rituals and teachings into the wider world.
lore.fullText: You were trained within a religious institution and now operate beyond its walls as a mediator, guide, or missionary.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.featureDescription: High society recognises your station. You can secure audiences and social access that common travellers cannot.
ideals: Leadership. My station obliges me to protect others.
Power. Influence exists to be used decisively.
Responsibility. Nobility without duty is rot.
bonds: My house's name must be restored.
I will not let rivals humiliate my family.
I owe loyalty to retainers who stood by me.
flaws: I can be arrogant with people beneath my station.
I am slow to trust those outside elite circles.
personalityTraits: I speak with practiced poise, even under pressure.
I notice breaches of etiquette immediately.
I offer generosity publicly and strategically.

lore.shortDescription: A person of title, wealth, or inherited influence, trained to navigate status and power.
lore.fullText: You grew up around courts, obligations, and political leverage. Your social access often opens doors before force does.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.featureDescription: Soldiers loyal to your former organisation recognise your rank and can offer practical assistance in military contexts.
ideals: Duty. Orders exist for a reason.
Nation. I fight to defend my people.
bonds: I protect comrades who survived my old campaign.
I must honour the fallen who trained me.
I carry a debt to my old commanding officer.
flaws: I default to violence too quickly.
I can become reckless when challenged.
I have little patience for civilian caution.
personalityTraits: I keep my kit immaculate and ready.
I evaluate every room as a battlefield.
I rely on clear chains of command.

lore.shortDescription: A veteran of organised warfare who understands discipline, logistics, and command structures.
lore.fullText: You served in a formal military force and learned to survive under pressure, obey orders, and maintain cohesion in chaos.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.featureDescription: You have a trusted underworld contact who can pass messages and rumours through illicit networks.
ideals: Freedom. No authority should own my choices.
Survival. I do what keeps me alive.
bonds: I protect the person who taught me the trade.
I owe a dangerous debt from a failed job.
I want to dismantle the gang that betrayed me.
flaws: I distrust almost everyone by default.
I keep secrets even when honesty is safer.
I chase high-risk scores when I should walk away.
personalityTraits: I always identify exits and blind spots first.
I bargain hard and never reveal my full hand.
I use humour to deflect suspicion.

lore.shortDescription: A former lawbreaker accustomed to covert networks, coded communication, and operating outside institutions.
lore.fullText: You learned to exploit social and physical gaps in the law, and you still carry contacts and instincts from that world.
